Executes `/bin/sh -c <command>` inside that plan with the effective timeout.\n    /// 6. Returns a JSON `ToolOutput` with `exit_code`, `stdout`, `stderr`, and `truncated`.\n    ///\n    /// # Arguments\n    /// - `context` (`&ToolExecutionContext`): harness-established sandbox authority.\n    /// - `call` (`&ToolCall`): untrusted invocation; `arguments` must match [`ShellExecArgs`].\n    ///\n    /// # Returns\n    /// `Ok(ToolOutput::json(...))` on success, `Ok(ToolOutput::error(...))` on permission\n    /// denial or runtime failure, `Err(ToolsError::InvalidArguments)` if arguments cannot\n    /// be parsed.\n    ///\n    /// # Errors\n    /// - [`ToolsError::InvalidArguments`]: arguments JSON does not conform to the tool schema.\n    ///\n    /// # Concurrency\n    /// `Send + Sync`. The returned future is `Send`.\n    ///\n    /// # Panics\n    /// None.\n    ///\n    /// # Examples\n    /// ```rust,no_run\n    /// use harw_tool_shell::ShellToolProvider;\n    /// use harw_extension_api::contributors::ToolProvider;\n    /// use harw_tools::spec::ToolName;\n    ///\n    /// let provider = ShellToolProvider::new();\n    /// let executor = provider.executor(&ToolName::new(\"shell.exec\")).unwrap();\n    /// // executor.execute(&ctx, &call).await\n    /// ```\n    fn execute<'a>(\n        &'a self,\n        context: &'a ToolExecutionContext,\n        call: &'a ToolCall,\n    ) -> ToolExecutorFuture<'a> {\n        Box::pin(async move {\n            // 1. Parse arguments\n            let args: ShellExecArgs =\n                serde_json::from_value(call.arguments.clone()).map_err(|err| {\n                    ToolsError::InvalidArguments {\n                        name: TOOL_NAME.to_owned(),\n                        reason: err.to_string(),\n                    }\n                })?;\n\n            // 2. Reject invalid caller-controlled values before sandbox planning or spawn.\n            self.effective_timeout(&args)?;\n\n            // 3. Permission check\n            if let Some(err) = harw_tools::sandbox_guard::require_permission(\n                conte�─────────────\n\n/// The decided values applied to a position before BAPI assembly.\nstruct DecisionOverlay {\n    gl_account: String,\n    cost_center: Option<String>,\n}\n\n/// Reduce decisions to the latest one per `ITEMNO_ACC` (decisions carry `itemno_acc` as text).\n///\n/// Decisions whose `itemno_acc` is absent or non-numeric are ignored here — see\n/// [`latest_whole_invoice_decision`] for those. When several decisions target the\n/// same line, the one with the most recent `decided_at` wins.\nfn latest_decisions_by_itemno(decisions: &[DecisionRecord]) -> HashMap<i32, DecisionOverlay> {\n    let mut latest: HashMap<i32, (DateTime<Utc>, DecisionOverlay)> = HashMap::new();\n    for decision in decisions {\n        let Some(itemno) = decision\n            .itemno_acc\n            .as_deref()\n            .and_then(|s| s.trim().parse::<i32>().ok())\n        else {\n            continue;\n        };\n        let is_newer = match latest.get(&itemno) {\n            Some((existing_at, _)) => decision.decided_at >= *existing_at,\n            None => true,\n        };\n        if is_newer {\n            latest.insert(\n                itemno,\n                (\n                    decision.decided_at,\n                    DecisionOverlay {\n                        gl_account: decision.gl_account.clone(),\n                        cost_center: decision.cost_center.clone(),\n                    },\n                ),\n            );\n        }\n    }\n    latest\n        .into_iter()\n        .map(|(itemno, (_, overlay))| (itemno, overlay))\n        .collect()\n}\n\n/// Find the most recent \"whole invoice\" decision — one recorded with no\n/// `itemno_acc` (see `POST /accept` with an empty `items` array, the common path\n/// for single-line invoices or a blanket approval covering every GL line).\n///\n/// # Description\n///\n/// [`latest_decisions_by_itemno`] silently drops every decision lacking a numeric\n/// `itemno_acc`, which historically meant a whole-invoice \"approved\" decision\n/// never reached [`overlay_and_assemble`] — the assembled BAPI document fell back\n/// to the raw extraction skeleton's literal `\"Platzhalter\"` GL account even though\n/// a human/AI decision had genuinely approved a real account. This helper recovers\n/// that decision so it can be applied as the default for every `ACCOUNTGL` line\n/// that has no more specific per-item override.\n///\n/// # Arguments\n/// - `decisions` (`&[DecisionRecord]`): all decisions loaded for the invoice.\n///\n/// # Returns\n/// `Some(DecisionOverlay)` for the latest (`decided_at` DESC) decision with an\n/// absent/blank `itemno_acc`, or `None` when every decision is per-item.\nfn latest_whole_invoice_decision(decisions: &[DecisionRecord]) -> Option<DecisionOverlay> {\n    decisions\n        .iter()\n        .filter(|d| {\n            d.itemno_acc\n                .as_deref()\n                .map(|s| s.trim().is_empty())\n                .unwrap_or(true)\n        })\n        .max_by_key(|d| d.decided_at)\n        .map(|d| DecisionOverlay {\n            gl_account: d.gl_account.clone(),\n            cost_center: d.cost_center.clone(),\n        })\n}\n\n/// Overlay the approved decisions onto the positions and assemble a balanced BAPI document.\n///\n/// # Errors\n/// Propagates [`crate::bapi::error::BapiError`] from assembly / balance validation (e.g.\n/// a missing GL account or an unbalanced document).\nfn overlay_and_assemble(\n    assembled: &AssembledInvoice,\n    decisions: &[DecisionRecord],\n) -> BapiResult<BapiDocument> {\n    let overlays = latest_decisions_by_itemno(decisions);\n    // Fallback for the common \"whole invoice\" accept path (no per-item overrides\n    // submitted): applies to every ACCOUNTGL line lacking a more specific per-item\n    // decision, so the approved account replaces the raw extraction's placeholder\n    // instead of a per-item decision requirement silently never being met.\n    let whole_invoice_overlay = latest_whole_invoice_decision(decisions);\n    let mut positions = assembled.positions.clone();\n    for pos in &mut positions {\n        if let Some(overlay) = overlays.get(&pos.itemno_acc) {\n            pos.gl_account = Some(overlay.gl_account.clone());\n            if overlay.cost_center.is_some() {\n                pos.cost_center = overlay.cost_center.clone();\n            }\n        } else if pos.position_type == PositionType::Gl\n            && let Some(overlay) = &whole_invoice_overlay\n        {\n            pos.gl_account = Some(overlay.gl_account.clone());\n            if overlay.cost_center.is_some() {\n                pos.cost_center = overlay.cost_center.clone();\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    if let Some(vat) =\n        synthesize_vat_position(&assembled.header, &positions, &assembled.raw_payload)\n    {\n        positions.push(vat);\n    }\n    let document = assemble(&assembled.header, &positions)?\n        .validate_balance()?\n        .into_document();\n    Ok(document)\n}\n\n/// Compute the unbalanced delta (debit - credit) over the given positions using the\n/// same sign convention as `bapi::builder::validate_balance`:\n/// positive `amt_doccur` = debit, negative = credit. Returns `debit - credit`.\n///\n/// # Description\n///\n/// Iterates all positions that carry `Some(amt_doccur)` and accumulates two buckets:\n/// non-negative values sum into `debit`, negative values sum their magnitude into `credit`.\n/// Returns `debit - credit`:\n/// - `> 0` → more debit than credit (document short a credit).\n/// - `< 0` → more credit than debit (document short a debit).\n/// - `== 0` → already balanced.\n///\n/// # Arguments\n///\n/// - `positions` (`&[InvoicePosition]`): the current set of assembled positions. Positions\n///   with `amt_doccur == None` are skipped (they do not contribute to the balance).\n///\n/// # Returns\n///\n/// [`Decimal`] — the signed delta `debit - credit`. Zero means balanced.\n///\n/// # Concurrency\n///\n/// Pure function; no shared state. Safe to call from any thread.\n///\n/// # Examples\n///\n/// ```rust,no_run\n/// // net +100 debit, -100 credit → delta == 0 (balanced)\n/// // net +200 debit, -100 credit → delta == +100 (short a credit)\n/// ```\nfn position_balance_delta(positions: &[InvoicePosition]) -> Decimal {\n    let mut debit = Decimal::ZERO;\n    let mut credit = Decimal::ZERO;\n    for pos in positions {\n        if let Some(amt) = pos.amt_doccur {\n            if amt.is_sign_negative() {\n                credit -= amt; // subtract negative → add magnitude\n            } else {\n                debit += amt;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    debit - credit\n}\n\n/// Synthesize a single balancing VAT Tax position from the raw payload's\n/// `tax.breakdown`, but ONLY when (a) the assembled positions are unbalanced and\n/// (b) the magnitude of the imbalance equals the summed `tax_amount.value` of the\n/// breakdown (within zero tolerance). Injects a `PositionType::Tax` position whose\n/// `amt_doccur` is exactly the signed delta needed to reach balance (so debits ==\n/// credits). Returns `Some(position)` to inject, or `None` to leave positions as-is.\n/// Never fabricates an amount not present in `tax.breakdown`.\n///\n/// # Description\n///\n/// Guards against over-injection: returns `None` when the document is already balanced,\n/// when a `Tax` position already exists in `positions`, or when the breakdown VAT total\n/// does not exactly match the imbalance magnitude. The injected `amt_doccur` is `-delta`\n/// so that `position_balance_delta` yields zero after the push.\n///\n/// # Arguments\n///\n/// - `header` (`&InvoiceHeader`): used for `invoice_id` and `id` on the synthesized row.\n/// - `positions` (`&[InvoicePosition]`): the current assembled positions (post-overlay).\n/// - `raw_payload` (`&JsonValue`): the raw extracted payload; VAT breakdown lives at\n///   `[\"tax\"][\"breakdown\"][i]` with `tax_amount.value` (STRING decimal), `tax_amount.currency`,\n///   `taxable_amount.value`, and `category_code`.\n///\n/// # Returns\n///\n/// `Some(InvoicePosition)` when synthesis is warranted; `None` otherwise.\n///\n/// # Concurrency\n///\n/// Pure function (modulo `Uuid::new_v4()` and `Utc::now()`). Safe to call from any thread.\n///\n/// # Examples\n///\n/// ```rust,no_run\n/// // positions: GL +1009 debit + payable -1200.71 credit, breakdown tax_amount \"191.71\"\n/// // → returns Some with amt_doccur = 191.71 and position_type = Tax\n/// ```\nfn synthesize_vat_position(\n    header: &InvoiceHeader,\n    positions: &[InvoicePosition],\n    raw_payload: &JsonValue,\n) -> Option<InvoicePosition> {\n    let delta = position_balance_delta(positions);\n\n    // Already balanced — nothing to do.\n    if delta == Decimal::ZERO {\n        return None;\n    }\n\n    // A Tax position already exists — do not double-inject.\n    if positions\n        .iter()\n        .any(|p| p.position_type == PositionType::Tax)\n    {\n        return None;\n    }\n\n    // Parse the tax breakdown array.\n    let breakdown = raw_payload[\"tax\"][\"breakdown\"].as_array()?;\n\n    // Sum all tax_amount.value fields (STRING decimals) in the breakdown.\n    // Skip any entry that doesn't parse cleanly.\n    let mut vat_total = Decimal::ZERO;\n    let mut parsed_any = false;\n    for entry in breakdown {\n        if let Some(val) = entry[\"tax_amount\"][\"value\"]\n            .as_str()\n            .and_then(|s| s.parse::<Decimal>().ok())\n        {\n            vat_total += val;\n            parsed_any = true;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // If nothing parsed, bail out.\n    if !parsed_any {\n        return None;\n    }\n\n    // Only synthesize when the imbalance magnitude exactly equals the VAT total.\n    if vat_total.abs() != delta.abs() {\n        return None;\n    }\n\n    // Read supplementary fields from breakdown[0].\n    let bd0 = breakdown.first()?;\n    let tax_code = bd0[\"category_code\"].as_str().map(str::to_string);\n    let currency = bd0[\"tax_amount\"][\"currency\"].as_str().map(str::to_string);\n    let amt_base = bd0[\"taxable_amount\"][\"value\"]\n        .as_str()\n        .and_then(|s| s.parse::<Decimal>().ok());\n\n    // itemno_acc = max existing + 10\n    let itemno_acc = positions.iter().map(|p| p.itemno_acc).max().unwrap_or(0) + 10;\n\n    let now = Utc::now();\n\n    Some(InvoicePosition {\n        id: Uuid::new_v4(),\n        invoice_id: header.id,\n        itemno_acc,\n        position_type: PositionType::Tax,\n        gl_account: None,\n        cost_center: None,\n        func_area: None,\n        profit_ctr: None,\n        wbs_element: None,\n        order_id: None,\n        segment: None,\n        tax_code,\n        unit_code: None,\n        quantity: None,\n        item_text: Some(\"VAT (synthesized to balance)\".to_string()),\n        itemno_tax: None,\n        vendor_no: None,\n        baseline_date: None,\n        payment_terms: None,\n        payment_block: None,\n        payment_method: None,\n        partner_bank: None,\n        alloc_number: None,\n        description: None,\n        curr_type: Some(\"00\".to_string()),\n        currency,\n        amt_doccur: Some(-delta),\n        amt_base,\n        created_at: now,\n        updated_at: now,\n    })\n}\n\n// ── Handlers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// `GET /api/v1/invoices/{invoice_id}` — invoice header, payload, AI-coded items, and decisions.\nasync fn get_invoice_impl(\n    req: Request<Incoming>,\n    params: matchit::Params<'static, 'static>,\n    state: Arc<AppContext>,\n) -> HandlerResult {\n    let (claims, invoice_id) = match authorize(&req, &state, &params) {\n        Ok(v) => v,\n        Err(resp) => return resp,\n    };\n    let assembled = match load(&state, invoice_id, claims.organization_id).await {\n        Ok(a) => a,\n        Err(resp) => return resp,\n    };\n    // Merge header fields with the full extracted payload (xmlinvoice schema)\n    let header_value = match serde_json::to_value(&assembled.header) {\n        Ok(v) => v,\n        Err(_) => {\n            return error_response(\n serde_json::Value::Object(header_map) = header_value {\n        combined.extend(header_map);\n    }\n    if let serde_json::Value::Object(payload_map) = assembled.raw_payload.clone() {\n        combined.extend(payload_map);\n    }\n\n    // Add AI-coded line items (with hypothesis_gl_account, confidence, etc.)\n    if let Ok(Some(items)) = state\n        .invoice_items\n serde_json::json!({\n                    \"invoice_item_id\": r.invoice_item_id,\n                    \"itemno_acc\": r.itemno_acc,\n                    \"gl_account\": r.gl_account,\n                    \"cost_center\": r.cost_center,\n                    \"tax_code\": r.tax_code,\n                    \"quantity\": r.quantity.as_ref().map(|q| q.to_string()),\n                    \"item_text\": r.item_text,\n                    \"final_account_name\": r.final_account_name,\n                    \"final_gl_account\": r.final_gl_account,\n                    \"hypothesis_account_name\": r.hypothesis_account_name,\n                    \"hypothesis_gl_account\": r.hypothesis_gl_account,\n                    \"confidence\": r.confidence.as_ref().map(|c| c.to_string()),\n                    \"explanation\": r.explanation,\n                    \"kontenart\": r.kontenart,\n                })\n            })\n            .collect();\n        combined.insert(\"ai_items\".to_string(), serde_json::Value::Array(items_json));\n    }\n\n    // Add recorded decisions (final cost_center, gl_account, tax_treatment)\n    if let Ok(decisions) = state\n        .decision_service\n d_value);\n    }\n\n    json_response(StatusCode::OK, &serde_json::Value::Object(combined))\n}\n\n/// `GET /api/v1/invoices/{invoice_id}/bapi` — the SAP posting document (approved coding).\nasync fn bapi_impl(\n    req: Request<Incoming>,\n    params: matchit::Params<'static, 'static>,\n    state: Arc<AppContext>,\n) -> HandlerResult {\n    let (claims, invoice_id) = match authorize(&req, &state, &params) {\n        Ok(v) => v,\n        Err(resp) => return resp,\n    };\n    let assembled = match load(&state, invoice_id, claims.organization_id).await {\n        Ok(a) => a,\n        Err(resp) => return resp,\n    };\n    let decisions = match state\n        .decision_service\n        .get_decisions_by_invoice(invoice_id, claims.organization_id)\n        .await\n    {\n        Ok(d) => d,\n        Err(err) => {\n            tracing::error!(error = %err, %invoice_id, \"failed to load decisions for bapi\");\n            return error_response(\n                StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,\n                \"Failed to load decisions\",\n            );\n        }\n    };\n\n    // A BAPI document can only be assembled from APPROVED accounting decisions\n    // (`invoice_decisions`). Bitte den \\\n                            KI-Vorschlag prüfen und freigeben, bevor gebucht \\\n                            werden kann.\",\n                \"invoice_id\": invoice_id,\n            }),\n        );\n    }\n\n    match overlay_and_assemble(&assembled, &decisions) {\n        Ok(document) => match serde_json::to_value(&document) {\n            Ok(v) => json_response(StatusCode::OK, &v),\n            Err(_) => error_response(\n                StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,\n                \"Failed to serialize BAPI document\",\n            ),\n        },\n        // A document that cannot post (unbalanced, missing GL account, …) is a 422 with\n        // the exact reason, not a 500 — the caller must fix the data, not retry.\n        Err(bapi_err) => error_response(StatusCode::UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY, &bapi_err.to_string()),\n    }\n}\n\n/// `GET /api/v1/invoices/{invoice_id}/proposal` — the raw AI proposal payload, verbatim.\nasync fn proposal_impl(\n    req: Request<Incoming>,\n    params: matchit::Params<'static, 'static>,\n    state: Arc<AppContext>,\n) -> HandlerResult {\n    let (claims, invoice_id) = match authorize(&req, validation_sessions keys on a TEXT invoice id and carries an explicit organization_id;\n    // filter on both for tenant isolation. entries.push(TimelineEntry {\n        stage: format!(\"{:?}\", header.status).to_lowercase(),\n        at: header.updated_at,\n        by: None,\n    });\n    entries.sort_by_key(|entry| Identitäten entstehen entweder deterministisch abgeleitet\n# (UUIDv5, siehe apps/sgh-flow/src/platform/system_principal_id.rs) oder werden\n# nach dem Provisionieren aus der Antwort zurückgelesen und vom Werkzeug in die\n# Env-Datei geschrieben. Der Manifest-Parser weist UUID-förmige Werte aktiv ab\n# (crates/sgh-participant/src/infra.rs::reject_if_uuid_like).\n#\n# Grund: am 2026-07-29 hat genau dieser Handabtipp einen Produktionsausfall\n# verursacht — abgetippte *_SYSTEM_PRINCIPAL_ID-Werte drifteten auseinander und\n# secureHUB antwortete mit einem nackten 403, das nichts benannte.\n\nname = \"sgh-acct\"\nport = 4610\nsubject_kinds = [\"invoice\"]\nsecret_var = \"PARTICIPANT_SGH_ACCT_AUTH_TOKEN_SECRET\"\n# SGH_ACCT_PLATFORM_TOKEN (Slice W7-5, nicht hier deklariert — kein\n# manifest-getriebenes Feld dafuer): API-Key, den\n# sgh-acct-service::platform_client::PlatformClient als Authorization: Bearer\n# gegen die Plattform sendet (Scopes invoices:read/write/approve). SMART_AGENT_MODULE ist dort NICHT gesetzt →\n# Default aus config.rs greift: \"smart_accounter\" (hat ein main()).\n# run_v2.py/agent.runner_v2 (V2-Orchestrator) existiert bereits im Baum, ist\n# aber noch nicht der scharf geschaltete Pfad — SMART_AGENT_MODULE wird\n# nirgends auf \"run_v2\" gesetzt. max_workers = 5, venv-Basisname aus\n# SMART_AGENT_VENV=/srv/dev-shared/projects/rust/sgh-flow/sgh-flow-venv.\n# AZURE_*/SMART_*/SGH_*-Env wird vom Supervisor per Präfixfilter an den\n# Agenten durchgereicht.\n[agent]\nmodule_path = \"python_agent\"\nmodule = \"smart_accounter\"\nvenv = \"sgh-flow-venv\"\nargv = []\nmax_workers = 5\n\n# ── Infrastruktur ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n# Eigener Vault: sgh-acct hält Fachdaten (acctdb) und braucht eigenes\n# Schlüsselmaterial, nicht das geteilte System-Vault der drei Kern-Participants.\n[infrastructure.secrets]\nvault = \"own\"\n\n# Die Stores, die heute in api/admin_vector_store.rs als DEFAULT_STORE_KINDS\n# hartkodiert sind. Ab Etappe 5 ist DIESE Liste die Quelle; die Konstante bleibt\n# nur noch Fallback für Orgs ohne Manifest.\n# `kind` ist freiform — vectory ist domänenagnostisch (StoreKind::Other).\n#\n# ACHTUNG, aufgedeckte Drift (2026-08-05): der Python-Builder\n# sgh-acct/python_agent/scripts/build_org_vectors_vectory.py pflegt in\n# ALL_STORE_KINDS SIEBEN Kinds — inklusive `positions`, das die Rust-Konstante\n# DEFAULT_STORE_KINDS nicht führt. `positions` ist real: das MCP-Tool\n# `get_similar_positions` ist sein Konsument, und vectorys eigenes\n# register_org_vector_store-Schema listet es. Diese Datei führt deshalb alle\n# sieben — genau dafür gibt es die eine Quelle. Solange resolve_store_kinds()\n# noch mit None aufgerufen wird, ändert das am Laufzeitverhalten nichts.\n\n[[infrastructure.vector_stores]]\nkind = \"sachkonto\"\nembedding_model = \"multilingual-e5-large\"\ndimension = 1024\nsource = \"acctdb:sachkonto\"\n\n[[infrastructure.vector_stores]]\nkind = \"kreditor\"\nembedding_model = \"multilingual-e5-large\"\ndimension = 1024\nsource = \"acctdb:kreditor\"\n\n# Nur im Python-Builder geführt, in DEFAULT_STORE_KINDS bisher fehlend.\n[[infrastructure.vector_stores]]\nkind = \"positions\"\nembedding_model = \"multilingual-e5-large\"\ndimension = 1024\nsource = \"acctdb:invoice_item\"\n\n[[infrastructure.vector_stores]]\nkind = \"cost_center\"\nembedding_model = \"multilingual-e5-large\"\ndimension = 1024\nsource = \"acctdb:cost_center\"\n\n[[infrastructure.vector_stores]]\nkind = \"segment\"\nembedding_model = \"multilingual-e5-large\"\ndimension = 1024\nsource = \"acctdb:segment\"\n\n[[infrastructure.vector_stores]]\nkind = \"department\"\nembedding_model = \"multilingual-e5-large\"\ndimension = 1024\nsource = \"acctdb:department\"\n\n# Der decision-Store speist sich aus der Plattform-Wahrheit (Tabelle\n# `decisions`), nicht aus acctdb — sgh-acct liest sie über\n# GET /api/v1/decisions/{subject_kind}/{subject_id}.\n[[infrastructure.vector_stores]]\nkind = \"decision\"\nembedding_model = \"multilingual-e5-large\"\ndimension = 1024\nsource = \"platform:decisions?subject_kind=invoice\"\n\n# ── Iceberg ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n# Entspricht den Tabellen, die der (bis Etappe 6 in apps/sgh-flow liegende)\n# alte Iceberg-Pfad heute hart verdrahtet hat. Diese\nKopie läuft für sich (alle transitiven Abhängigkeiten des Einstiegsmoduls\n`smart_accounter` sowie des noch nicht scharf geschalteten V2-Pfads\n`run_v2`/`agent.runner_v2`/`agent.orchestrator_v2` sind mitkopiert), ist aber\nnoch nirgends verdrahtet (kein Makefile-Ziel zeigt hierher).\n\n**Korrektur zur Vorversion dieses Dokuments:** Die alte Fassung zeichnete eine\nTrennlinie \"fachlich vs. generisch mit Extraktionskandidaten\" und bezeichnete\nden Vektor-/Embedding-Stack an mehreren Stellen als etwas, das \"später\"\ngezogen werden könne. Das ist nach scope.md §4.3 falsch: der Vektor-Stack\n(Embeddings, FAISS-Index, Ähnlichkeitssuche) ist **dauerhaft** vectory-Aufgabe,\nnicht sgh-accts. Er wird hier nicht extrahiert, sondern **entfernt** — siehe\nAbschnitt \"Ausdrücklich nicht kopiert\" unten. Jede Formulierung, die den\nVektor-Stack als spätere Extraktion aus sgh-acct heraus nahelegte, ist mit\ndieser Fassung gestrichen.\n\n## Zähldisziplin (Nachweis §c)\n\n- Original (`apps/sgh-flow/python_agent/`, `*.py`, ohne `.venv/`,\n  `__pycache__/`): **164** Dateien.\n- Kopie (`sgh-acct/python_agent/`, `*.py`, ohne `.venv/`, `__pycache__/`):\n  **120** Dateien.\n- Differenz: **44** Dateien, einzeln unten mit Grund aufgeführt.\n- 120 + 44 = 164. ✓ (ermittelt per `find … -name \"*.py\" | wc -l` und\n  `diff` beider sortierter Dateilisten, 2026-08-10)\n\n## Top-Level-Skripte (kopiert)\n\n| Datei | Einordnung |\n|---|---|\n| `smart_accounter.py` | Rechnungsdomäne (V1-Einstiegspunkt, aktuell scharf geschaltet — siehe `participant.toml [agent].module`) |\n| `run_v2.py` | Rechnungsdomäne (V2-Einstiegspunkt, im Baum vorhanden, aktuell **nicht** über `SMART_AGENT_MODULE` aktiviert) |\n| `xml_to_bapi.py` | Rechnungsdomäne (SAP-BAPI-Transformation) |\n| `manage_invoice.py` | Rechnungsdomäne (Invoice-Lifecycle-CLI) |\n| `pdf_processor.py` | Rechnungsdomäne (PDF/Factur-X-Extraktion) |\n| `send.py`, `send_helpers.py`, `send_invoice.py` | Rechnungsdomäne (Versand/Rückmeldung an Plattform) |\n| `inbox.py` | Rechnungsdomäne (Posteingang/Polling) |\n| `db_data_helper.py` | Rechnungsdomäne (acctdb-Zugriffshelfer, SAP-BAPI-Tabellen). Parallelbahn P1 löst dieses Modul gerade vom FAISS-Stack — siehe Hinweis unten. |\n| `setup.py` | Build/Packaging. Parallelbahn P2 hat dieses Modul im Zugriff. |\n| `pyproject.toml` | Build/Packaging |\n\n## `agent/` — Kernpaket (kopiert)\n\nEnthält die Rechnungs-Pipeline (`specialists/`, `hypothesis/`, `evidence/`,\n`contracts/`, `mcp_tools/`) sowie das generische Agenten-Laufzeitgerüst\n(`orchestrator.py`, `orchestrator_v2.py`, `runner.py`, `runner_v2.py`,\n`providers.py`, `model_tiers.py`, `tracing.py`, `cost.py`, `errors.py`,\n`guardrails.py`, `secrets.py`, `iceberg_client.py`, `progress.py`,\n`progress_hooks.py`, `metrics_hooks.py`, `models/`, `runtimes/`,\n`writeback.py`, `run_config.py`, `mcp_client.py`, `registry.py`). Eine\ngenerisch/fachlich-Extraktionslinie innerhalb dieses Pakets ist **nicht**\nGegenstand dieses Dokuments — die einzige harte Grenze, die zählt, ist\nvectory vs. sgh-acct (siehe Korrektur oben).\n\n`agent/tools/faiss_tools.py`: Name ist historisch irreführend — das Modul\nimportiert weder `faiss` noch eines der entfernten Vektormodule (geprüft\n2026-08-10: nur `agents.RunContextWrapper`/`function_tool` und\n`agent.context.InvoiceSessionState`). Lesender HTTP-Client gegen `sgh-acctd` fuer KI-Monitor, Dashboard und Analytics.\n//!\n//! ## Warum es diesen Client gibt\n//!\n//! Nach dem Schnitt der Rechnungsdomaene (`sgh-acct/CONTRACT.md`) liegen\n//! `ai_progress_event`, `task`, `invoice_ingest`, `invoice_item`,\n//! `invoice_line_classifications` und `invoice_qa_findings` in `acctdb`,\n//! waehrend KI-Monitor, Dashboard und Analytics bei `sgh-flow` bleiben\n//! (`sgh-acct/NACHWEIS.md` §4.1). Ein SQL-Join ueber zwei Datenbanken ist\n//! nicht darstellbar — die acct-Anteile kommen deshalb ueber HTTP, die\n//! Plattformanteile (`invoice_decisions`, `audit_log`, `users`, `orgs`,\n//! `notifications`) bleiben lokale SQL-Abfragen, und das Zusammenfuehren\n//! passiert im Rust-Code der jeweiligen Route.\n//!\n//! ## Verantwortung\n//!\n//! Besitzt vier lesende Aufrufe:\n//!\n//! 1. `GET {base}/api/v1/admin/ai/monitor/events?since&invoice_id&limit`\n//!    (normativ `sgh-acct/ANALYTICS-API.md`)\n//! 2. `GET {base}/api/v1/admin/ai/monitor/tasks?status&limit`\n//!    (normativ `sgh-acct/ANALYTICS-API.md`)\n//! 3. `GET {base}/api/v1/admin/ai/analytics/summary?from&to`\n//!    (normativ `sgh-acct/ANALYTICS-API.md`)\n//! 4. `POST {base}/mcp` — generischer JSON-RPC-2.0-`tools/call`-Aufruf\n//!    ([`AcctClient::call_tool`]) fuer die drei Dashboard-Vertragswerkzeuge\n//!    `get_ai_monitor { window_minutes }`,\n//!    `get_ai_metrics_timeseries { from, to, bucket }` und\n//!    `list_ai_jobs { status?, limit? }`. Anders als die drei obigen Aufrufe\n//!    liefert dieser Pfad bereits die vollstaendige, von den Aufrufern\n//!    unveraendert durchgereichte Antwortform der jeweiligen Dashboard-Route\n//!    (`sgh-flow/src/api/admin_ai_monitor.rs`, `ai_metrics.rs`, `ai_jobs.rs`);\n//!    die drei aelteren Aufrufe bleiben als lokaler Notpfad bestehen, falls\n//!    `sgh-acctd` den `/mcp`-Aufruf nicht bedienen kann.\n//!\n//! Besitzt **nicht**: Schreibpfade nach `acctdb`, Entscheidungs- oder\n//! Auditwahrheit (bleibt Plattform), Vector-Store (bleibt vectory), und keine\n//! Iceberg-Oberflaeche (bleibt s3ice).\n//!\n//! ## Basis-URL\n//!\n//! Die Basis stammt aus der generischen Participant-Registry\n//! ([`crate::platform::registry::ParticipantRegistry`]), Eintrag `sgh-acct`,\n//! Feld `address` — also aus `PARTICIPANT_SGH_ACCT_ADDRESS` bzw.\n//! `PARTICIPANT_SGH_ACCT_PORT` (`apps/sgh-flow/src/config.rs`). Es wird\n//! bewusst **kein** neuer Konfigurationsschluessel eingefuehrt: der Client\n//! spricht denselben Participant an, den der Edge-Proxy unter `/acct`\n//! vorhaelt, nur direkt statt ueber den eigenen Proxy.\n//!\n//! ## Authentisierung\n//!\n//! Die drei aelteren REST-Aufrufe ([`AcctClient::monitor_events`],\n//! [`AcctClient::monitor_tasks`], [`AcctClient::analytics_summary`]) tragen\n//! zwei Nachweise, beide aus dem geteilten Geheimnis\n//! `PARTICIPANT_SGH_ACCT_AUTH_TOKEN_SECRET`:\n//!\n//! - ein kurzlebiges, organisationsgebundenes HS256-Bearer-Token (identisch\n//!   zum Muster in [`crate::api::dashboard`]),\n//! - die signierten `X-SGH-*`-Edge-Kopfzeilen (`Org-Id`, `Subject-Id`,\n//!   `Edge-Timestamp-Ms`, `Edge-Signature`) mit derselben Signaturformel wie\n//!   der Plattform-Proxy (`apps/sgh-flow/src/platform/inbound.rs`,\n//!   `participant_edge_signature_header`).\n//!\n//! [`AcctClient::call_tool`] (der `/mcp`-Pfad) traegt zwei ANDERE, vom\n//! Kontrakt vorgegebene Nachweise:\n//!\n//! - `Authorization: Bearer $SGH_ACCT_AUTH_TOKEN` — dasselbe statische,\n//!   geteilte Dienst-Token, das `sgh-acctd` bereits fuer sein `/mcp`\n//!   akzeptiert (siehe `apps/sgh-flow/src/services/acct_shadow.rs`,\n//!   `apps/sgh-flow/src/cli/acct.rs`). Kein pro-Aufruf gemintetes JWT.\n//! - dieselben signierten `X-SGH-*`-Edge-Kopfzeilen wie oben, ueber\n//!   `PARTICIPANT_SGH_ACCT_AUTH_TOKEN_SECRET` signiert — sie tragen die\n//!   verifizierte `organization_id` des aufrufenden Admin-Claims, denn das\n//!   statische Bearer-Token allein enthaelt keine Mandanteninformation.\n//!\n//! ## Fehler\n//!\n//! Alle Fehler dieses Moduls sind [`AcctClientError`]; [`Result`] ist der\n//! zugehoerige Alias.\n//!\n//! ## Nebenlaeufigkeit\n//!\n//! [`AcctClient`] kapselt einen `reqwest::Client` (intern verbindungsgepoolt)\n//! und ist `Clone + Send + Sync`; gefahrlos ueber `Arc` teilbar.\n//!\n//! ## Examples\n//!\n//! ```rust,no_run\n//! use sgh_flow::services::acct_client::{AcctClient, MonitorEventsQuery};\n//! use uuid::Uuid;\n//!\n//! # async fn example(base: &str) -> sgh_flow::services::acct_client::Result<()> {\n//! let client = AcctClient::new(base)?;\n//! let org = Uuid::new_v4();\n//! let events = client\n//!     .monitor_events(org, &MonitorEventsQuery { limit: Some(30), ..Default::default() })\n//!     .await?;\n//! let _ = events.len();\n//! # Ok(())\n//! # }\n//! ```\n\nuse std::fmt;\nuse std::sync::Arc;\nuse std::time::Duration;\n\nuse chrono::Utc;\nuse hmac::{Hmac, Mac};\nuse jsonwebtoken::{Algorithm, EncodingKey, Header};\nuse serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};\nuse serde_json::{Value, json};\nuse sha2::Sha256;\nuse uuid::Uuid;\n\nuse crate::app::AppContext;\n\n// ─── Konstanten Umgebungsvariable mit dem geteilten Geheimnis zwischen sgh-flow und sgh-acctd.\nconst ACCT_SECRET_VAR: &str = \"PARTICIPANT_SGH_ACCT_AUTH_TOKEN_SECRET\";\n\n/// Umgebungsvariable mit dem statischen Dienst-Bearer-Token fuer `sgh-acctd`s\n/// `/mcp`-Endpunkt (dasselbe Token, das `acct_shadow.rs` und `cli/acct.rs`\n/// bereits verwenden — kein pro-Aufruf gemintetes JWT).\nconst ACCT_BEARER_TOKEN_VAR: &str = \"SGH_ACCT_AUTH_TOKEN\";\n\n/// Gesamtzeitlimit eines einzelnen Aufrufs.\n///\n/// Bewusst knapp: der KI-Monitor wird im Sekundentakt gepollt: ein haengender\n/// acct-Aufruf duerfte die Oberflaeche nicht blockieren, sondern muss zuegig\n/// in den Teilausfall laufen.\nconst REQUEST_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(5);\n\n/// Lebensdauer eines ausgestellten Lese-Tokens in Sekunden.\nconst TOKEN_TTL_SECS: i64 = 300;\n\n/// Fester Dienst-Principal fuer Aufrufe von sgh-flow an sgh-acct.\n///\n/// Eigene Konstante statt Wiederverwendung des ([`crate::services::acct_shadow`]) seinen Edge-Kontext mit **diesem**\n/// Subjekt signiert: eine zweite Konstante waere eine zweite erfundene\n/// Identitaet fuer denselben Dienst-zu-Dienst-Weg.\npub(crate) const ACCT_READ_SERVICE_SUBJECT: Uuid =\n    Uuid::from_u128(0x7c11_9d3a_51b4_4f27_8e6a_0b3c_5d7e_9f10);\n\n/// Fester `api_key_id`-Claim der ausgestellten ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Fehler dieses Clients.\n///\n/// Jede Variante traegt genug Zusammenhang, um den Ausfall ohne Quelltext zu\n/// verstehen — Aufrufer stufen daraus ihren Teilausfall ein.\npub enum AcctClientError {\n    /// Der Participant `sgh-acct` ist nicht registriert oder abgeschaltet.\n    ParticipantUnavailable(String),\n    /// Die Participant-Registry konnte nicht gelesen werden.\n    Registry(crate::error::AppError),\n    /// Das geteilte Geheimnis fehlt oder ist leer.\n    SecretMissing {\n        /// Name der erwarteten Umgebungsvariablen.\n        variable: String,\n    },\n    /// Das Lese-Token liess sich nicht signieren.\n    TokenMint(String),\n    /// Verbindungs-, TLS- oder Zeitueberschreitungsfehler.\n    Transport(reqwest::Error),\n    /// `sgh-acctd` hat mit einem Nicht-2xx-Status geantwortet.\n    HttpStatus {\n        /// HTTP-Statuscode der Antwort.\n        status: u16,\n        /// Angeforderter Pfad, ohne Basis-URL.\n        path: String,\n        /// Antwortkoerper, auf 512 Zeichen gekuerzt.\n        body: String,\n    },\n    /// Die Antwort war kein gueltiges JSON der erwarteten Form.\n    Decode {\n        /// Angeforderter Pfad, ohne Basis-URL.\n        path: String,\n        /// Meldung des Deserialisierers.\n        reason: String,\n    },\n    /// Die Basis-URL des Participants ist leer oder unbrauchbar.\n    InvalidBaseUrl(String),\n}\n\nimpl fmt::Display for AcctClientError {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {\n        match self {\n            Self::ParticipantUnavailable(detail) => {\n                write!(f, \"sgh-acct participant is unavailable: {detail}\")\n            }\n            Self::Registry(error) => {\n                write!(f, \"participant registry lookup failed: {error}\")\n            }\n            Self::SecretMissing { variable } => write!(\n                f,\n                \"shared secret {variable} is unset or empty; cannot authenticate to sgh-acctd\"\n            ),\n            Self::TokenMint(reason) => {\n                write!(f, \"could not mint an sgh-acct read token: {reason}\")\n HTTP {status} for {path}: {body}\")\n            }\n            Self::Decode { path, reason } => {\n                write!(f, \"sgh-acctd response for {path} did not decode: {reason}\")\n            }\n            Self::InvalidBaseUrl(detail) => {\n                write!(f, \"sgh-acct base URL is unusable: {detail}\")\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Debug delegiert bewusst an Display: eine Formulierung, keine zweite Wahrheit.\nimpl fmt::Debug for AcctClientError {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {\n        fmt::Display::fmt(self, f)\n    }\n}\n\nimpl std::error::Error for AcctClientError {\n    fn source(&self) -> Option<&(dyn std::error::Error + 'static)> {\n        match self {\n            Self::Transport(error) => Some(error),\n B. `queued`.\n    pub status: Option<String>,\n    /// Obergrenze der zurueckgegebenen Tasks.\n    pub limit: Option<u32>,\n}\n\n/// Zeitraum fuer `GET /api/v1/admin/ai/analytics/summary`.\n#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default)]\npub struct AnalyticsSummaryQuery {\n    /// Beginn des Zeitraums, einschliesslich.\n    pub from: Option<chrono::DateTime<chrono::Utc>>,\n    /// Ende des Zeitraums, ausschliesslich.\n    pub to: Option<chrono::DateTime<chrono::Utc>>,\n}\n\n// ─── Client ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Schlanker Lese-Client gegen `sgh-acctd`.\n#[derive(Clone)]\npub struct AcctClient {\n    http: reqwest::Client,\n    base_url: String,\n}\n\nimpl fmt::Debug for AcctClient {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {\n        f.debug_struct(\"AcctClient\")\n            .field(\"base_url\", &self.base_url)\n            .finish()\n    }\n}\n\nimpl AcctClient {\n    /// Erzeugt einen Client gegen eine bereits bekannte Basis-URL.\n    ///\n    /// # Arguments\n    ///\n    /// - `base_url` (`&str`): Ursprung von `sgh-acctd`, z. B.\n    ///   `http://127.0.0.1:18183`. Ein abschliessender Schraegstrich wird\n    ///   entfernt.\n    ///\n    /// # Returns\n    ///\n    /// `Ok(AcctClient)` mit einem verbindungsgepoolten `reqwest::Client`.\n    ///\n    /// # Errors\n    ///\n    /// - [`AcctClientError::InvalidBaseUrl`] — `base_url` ist leer.\n    /// - [`AcctClientError::Transport`] — der HTTP-Client liess sich nicht bauen.\n    pub fn new(base_url: &str) -> Result<Self> {\n        let trimmed = base_url.trim().trim_end_matches('/');\n        if trimmed.is_empty() {\n            return Err(AcctClientError::InvalidBaseUrl(\n                \"empty address; set PARTICIPANT_SGH_ACCT_ADDRESS or PARTICIPANT_SGH_ACCT_PORT\"\n                    .to_owned(),\n            ));\n        }\n        let http = reqwest::Client::builder()\n            .timeout(REQUEST_TIMEOUT)\n            .build()?;\n        Ok(Self {\n            http,\n            base_url: trimmed.to_owned(),\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// Erzeugt einen Client aus der Participant-Registry des Anwendungszustands.\n    ///\n    /// # Description\n    ///\n    /// Kein eigener Konfigurationsschluessel: die Adresse kommt aus dem\n    /// generischen Participant-Eintrag `sgh-acct`, genau wie beim Edge-Proxy.\n    ///\n    /// # Arguments\n    ///\n    /// - `state` (`&Arc<AppContext>`): liefert `participant_registry`.\n    ///\n    /// # Returns\n    ///\n    /// `Ok(AcctClient)` wenn der Participant registriert und aktiv ist.\n    ///\n    /// # Errors\n    ///\n    /// - [`AcctClientError::Registry`] — die Registry war nicht lesbar.\n    /// - [`AcctClientError::ParticipantUnavailable`] — kein aktiver Eintrag `sgh-acct`.\n    /// - [`AcctClientError::InvalidBaseUrl`] — der Eintrag hat keine Adresse.\n    /// - [`AcctClientError::Transport`] — der HTTP-Client liess sich nicht bauen.\n    pub async fn from_state(state: &Arc<AppContext>) -> Result<Self> {\n        let participant = state\n            .participant_registry\n            .get(SGH_ACCT_PARTICIPANT_ID)\n            .await?\n            .filter(|participant| participant.enabled)\n            .ok_or_else(|| {\n                AcctClientError::ParticipantUnavailable(format!(\n                    \"participant '{SGH_ACCT_PARTICIPANT_ID}' is not registered or not enabled\"\n                ))\n            })?;\n        Self::new(&participant.address)\n    }\n\n    /// Holt Fortschrittsereignisse aus `acctdb`.\n    ///\n    /// # Arguments\n    ///\n    /// - `organization_id` (`Uuid`): Mandant, an den Token und Edge-Kopfzeilen\n    ///   gebunden werden.\n    /// - `query` (`&MonitorEventsQuery`): optionale Filter.\n    ///\n    /// # Returns\n    ///\n    /// `Ok(Vec<AcctProgressEvent>)`, moeglicherweise leer.\n    ///\n    /// # Errors\n    ///\n    /// - [`AcctClientError::SecretMissing`] / [`AcctClientError::TokenMint`] —\n    ///   Authentisierung nicht moeglich.\n    /// - [`AcctClientError::Transport`] — sgh-acctd nicht erreichbar.\n    /// - [`AcctClientError::HttpStatus`] — Nicht-2xx-Antwort.\n    /// - [`AcctClientError::Decode`] — Antwort passt nicht auf die Wire-Form.\n    pub async fn monitor_events(\n        &self,\n        organization_id: Uuid,\n        query: &MonitorEventsQuery,\n    ) -> Result<Vec<AcctProgressEvent>> {\n        let mut pairs: Vec<(&str, String)> = Vec::new();\n        if let Some(since) = query.since {\n            pairs.push((\"since\", since.to_rfc3339()));\n        }\n        if let Some(invoice_id) = query.invoice_id {\n            pairs.push((\"invoice_id\", invoice_id.to_string()));\n        }\n        if let Some(limit) = query.limit {\n            pairs.push((\"limit\", limit.to_string()));\n        }\n        let path = with_query(\"/api/v1/admin/ai/monitor/events\", &pairs);\n        let envelope: MonitorEventsEnvelope = self.get_json(organization_id, &path).await?;\n        Ok(envelope.events)\n    }\n\n    /// Holt Warteschlangeneintraege aus `acctdb.task`.\n    ///\n    /// # Arguments\n    ///\n    /// - `organization_id` (`Uuid`): Mandant.\n    /// - `query` (`&MonitorTasksQuery`): optionale Filter.\n    ///\n    /// # Returns\n    ///\n    /// `Ok(Vec<AcctTask>)`, moeglicherweise leer.\n    ///\n    /// # Errors\n    ///\n    /// Wie [`AcctClient::monitor_events`].\n    pub async fn monitor_tasks(\n        &self,\n        organization_id: Uuid,\n        query: &MonitorTasksQuery,\n    ) -> Result<Vec<AcctTask>> {\n        let mut pairs: Vec<(&str, String)> = Vec::new();\n        if let Some(status) = query.status.as_deref() {\n            pairs.push((\"status\", status.to_owned()));\n        }\n        if let Some(limit) = query.limit {\n            pairs.push((\"limit\", limit.to_string()));\n        }\n        let path = with_query(\"/api/v1/admin/ai/monitor/tasks\", &pairs);\n        let envelope: MonitorTasksEnvelope = self.get_json(organization_id, &path).await?;\n        Ok(envelope.tasks)\n    }\n\n    /// Holt das Analytics-Aggregat aus `acctdb`.\n    ///\n    /// # Arguments\n    ///\n    /// - `organization_id` (`Uuid`): Mandant.\n    /// - `query` (`&AnalyticsSummaryQuery`): Zeitraum, beide Grenzen optional.\n    ///\n    /// # Returns\n    ///\n    /// `Ok(AcctAnalyticsSummary)` — fehlende Felder zaehlen als 0.\n    ///\n    /// # Errors\n    ///\n    /// Wie [`AcctClient::monitor_events`].\n    pub async fn analytics_summary(\n        &self,\n        organization_id: Uuid,\n        query: &AnalyticsSummaryQuery,\n    ) -> Result<AcctAnalyticsSummary> {\n        let mut pairs: Vec<(&str, String)> = Vec::new();\n        if let Some(from) = query.from {\n            pairs.push((\"from\", from.to_rfc3339()));\n        }\n        if let Some(to) = query.to {\n            pairs.push((\"to\", to.to_rfc3339()));\n        }\n        let path = with_query(\"/api/v1/admin/ai/analytics/summary\", &pairs);\n        self.get_json(organization_id, &path).await\n    }\n\n    /// Ruft ein MCP-Werkzeug von `sgh-acctd` per JSON-RPC-2.0 `tools/call` auf.\n    ///\n    /// # Description\n    ///\n    /// Fuer die drei Dashboard-Vertragswerkzeuge `get_ai_monitor`,\n    /// `get_ai_metrics_timeseries` und `list_ai_jobs` — normativ in\n    /// `sgh-acct/CONTRACT.md` als Gegenstueck zu den drei\n    /// sgh-flow-Handlern `admin_ai_monitor.rs`, `ai_metrics.rs`, `ai_jobs.rs`\n    /// beschrieben. Anders als [`AcctClient::monitor_events`] und\n    /// Geschwister liefert `sgh-acctd` hier bereits die vollstaendige,\n    /// unveraendert an die WebUI durchreichbare Antwortform der jeweiligen\n    /// Route — der Aufrufer muss das JSON nicht mehr zusammensetzen.\n    ///\n    /// # Arguments\n    ///\n    /// - `organization_id` (`Uuid`): Mandant, an den die Edge-Kopfzeilen\n    ///   gebunden werden; muss aus den bereits verifizierten Admin-Claims\n    ///   des Aufrufers stammen, niemals aus Nutzereingabe.\n    /// - `name` (`&str`): Werkzeugname, z. B. `\"get_ai_monitor\"`.\n    /// - `arguments` (`Value`): `params.arguments` des JSON-RPC-Aufrufs.\n    ///\n    /// # Returns\n    ///\n    /// `Ok(Value)` — der `result`-Teil der JSON-RPC-Antwort, unveraendert.\n    ///\n    /// # Errors\n    ///\n    /// - [`AcctClientError::SecretMissing`] — `SGH_ACCT_AUTH_TOKEN` oder\n    ///   `PARTICIPANT_SGH_ACCT_AUTH_TOKEN_SECRET` fehlt oder ist leer.\n    /// - [`AcctClientError::TokenMint`] — die Edge-Signatur liess sich nicht\n    ///   berechnen.\n    /// - [`AcctClientError::Transport`] — `sgh-acctd` nicht erreichbar.\n    /// - [`AcctClientError::HttpStatus`] — Nicht-2xx-Antwort oder ein\n    ///   JSON-RPC-`error`-Umschlag (als Status `502` gemeldet).\n    /// - [`AcctClientError::Decode`] — die Antwort ist kein gueltiges JSON\n    ///   oder traegt kein `result`-Feld.\n    pub async fn call_tool(&self, organization_id: Uuid, name: &str, arguments: Value) -> Result<Value> {\n        let bearer = read_bearer_token()?;\n        let secret = read_shared_secret()?;\n        let timestamp_ms = Utc::now().timestamp_millis();\n        let signature = edge_signature(\n            organization_id,\n            ACCT_READ_SERVICE_SUBJECT,\n            timestamp_ms,\n            &secret,\n        )?;\n\n        let body = build_tools_call_body(name, arguments);\n        let url = format!(\"{}/mcp\", self.base_url);\n        tracing::debug!(tool = name, %organization_id, \"acct_client: outbound mcp tools/call\");\n\n        let response = self\n            .http\n            .post(&url)\n            .bearer_auth(bearer)\n            .header(\"X-SGH-Org-Id\", organization_id.to_string())\n            .header(\"X-SGH-Subject-Id\", ACCT_READ_SERVICE_SUBJECT.to_string())\n            .header(\"X-SGH-Edge-Timestamp-Ms\", timestamp_ms.to_string())\n            .header(\"X-SGH-Edge-Signature\", signature)\n            .json(&body)\n            .send()\n            .await?;\n\n        let status = response.status();\n        if !status.is_success() {\n            let body_text = response.text().await.unwrap_or_default();\n            let mut truncated = body_text;\n\n[fs.read: Ausgabe gekürzt auf 25000 Bytes (Bytes 0..25000 von 46132); weiterlesen mit offset=25000]"},"duration_ms":1,"trust":"untrusted"}}

Fire-and-forget shadow-ingest hook into `sgh-acct` (Teilbahn D3, Etappe 4c).\n//!\n//! ## Responsibility\n//!\n//! This module owns [`ShadowIngestPayload`] and [`shadow_ingest`] — a thin,\n//! best-effort POST of an already-persisted platform invoice upload to\n//! `sgh-acctd`'s `POST /shadow/ingest` (see\n//! `sgh-acct/crates/sgh-acctd/src/app.rs::handle_shadow_ingest`), gated\n//! behind the `SGH_ACCT_SHADOW_ENABLED` feature flag. `invoice_ingest` (and\n//! the matching `invoice_payloads` row) is one of the three tables\n//! `sgh-acct` owns and writes itself, exactly through this endpoint —\n//! `sgh-acct/CONTRACT.md` §3.1 \"Tabellen, die sgh-acct BESITZT und selbst\n//! beschreibt\".\n//!\n//! It does **not** own:\n//! - The decision of *when* to call [`shadow_ingest`] during upload — this\n//!   Etappe's task brief is explicit that this module must be provided but\n//!   **not** wired into `apps/sgh-flow/src/services/upload.rs` yet. The\n//!   integration pass owns that call site (see the module-level \"Wiring\n//!   point\" note below).\n//! - Decision/Audit/Provenance truth, which stays on the platform\n//!   (`sgh-acct/CONTRACT.md` §4 \"Was bei der PLATTFORM bleibt\") — this hook\n//!   only mirrors the raw ingest blob reference + extracted JSON into\n//!   `acctdb`, it never reads anything back.\n//!\n//! ## ID-Parität Plattform ↔ acctdb\n//!\n//! [`ShadowIngestPayload::ingest_id`] trägt die Plattform-`invoice_ingest.id`\n//! (identisch mit `invoice_header.id`, siehe Feld-Doku) durch den Aufruf,\n//! damit `sgh-acctd` dieselbe ID statt einer selbst vergebenen benutzt —\n//! sonst finden PDF-Abruf, Validierung, Entscheidungen und der\n//! n8n-Integrator die acctdb-Zeile nicht mehr (Live-Befund 2026-09-09). Das\n//! ist unabhängig vom signierten `X-SGH-Subject-Id`-Header aus\n//! [`edge_context_pairs`]: jener trägt [`ACCT_READ_SERVICE_SUBJECT`], die\n//! **feste Dienst-Identität** von sgh-flow gegenüber sgh-acctd (dieselbe\n//! Konstante, die auch die Lese-Token-Aufrufe in\n//! `crate::services::acct_client` signiert) — er identifiziert den\n//! *Aufrufer*, nicht die einzelne Rechnung, und darf deshalb nicht auf die\n//! Ingest-ID umgestellt werden. Die Ingest-ID gehört ausschließlich in den\n//! JSON-Körper.\n//!\n//! ## Wiring point for the integration pass\n//!\n//! `apps/sgh-flow/src/services/upload.rs` is where the platform inserts the\n//! `invoice_ingest` row (via `InvoiceIngestRepository::insert_ingest`) and\n//! then the `invoice_payloads` row (via `insert_payload`) during the normal\n//! upload flow. The integration pass should call [`shadow_ingest`]\n//! immediately after both of those succeed, passing through the same field\n//! values used for the platform-side inserts (see [`ShadowIngestPayload`]'s\n//! field docs — they line up 1:1 with\n//! `crate::db::repositories::{InvoiceIngestInsert, InvoicePayloadInsert}`).\n//!\n//! ## Concurrency\n//!\n//! [`shadow_ingest`] is `async` and intended to be `tokio::spawn`ed by the\n//! caller for true fire-and-forget behavior (mirrors\n//! `InvoiceActionsService::spawn_audit_snapshot`'s pattern in\n//! `apps/sgh-flow/src/services/invoice_actions.rs`), though it is also safe\n//! to `.await` inline — it never returns `Err` to the caller.\n//!\n//! ## Errors\n//!\n//! [`shadow_ingest`] never returns `Err`: every failure (missing/invalid\n//! `SGH_ACCT_AUTH_TOKEN`, network error, non-2xx response, timeout) is\n//! logged via `tracing::warn!` and swallowed, per the task brief (\"Fehler\n//! nur warn!, nie den Aufrufer brechen\"). Seit T7-7 gilt dasselbe auch für\n//! eine **erfolgreiche** `202`-Antwort ohne tatsächlich eingereihten\n//! KI-Auftrag: `sgh-acctd` trägt `ai_enqueued`/`reason` im Antwortkörper\n//! (`sgh-acctd::app::shadow_ingest_accepted`); `classify_shadow_response`\n//! wertet das aus, und `ai_enqueued == false` wird als `tracing::warn!`\n//! protokolliert — nicht als Fehler dieses Hooks, sondern als Signal, dass\n//! die Rechnung ohne KI-Auftrag blieb. Fehlt das Feld (ältere `sgh-acctd`-\n//! Version), gilt das als `Unknown` und bleibt auf `debug!`, um keinen\n//! Warn-Spam gegen Bestandsinstallationen auszulösen.\n//!\n//! ## Statusspiegel Plattform → acctdb (seit 2026-09-09): Accept/Decline/Reroute/Nachvalidierung\n//!\n//! Neben dem einmaligen [`shadow_ingest`] beim Upload trägt [`shadow_status`]\n//! spätere Statusänderungen nach, die ausschließlich auf der Plattform\n//! entschieden werden — Annahme, Ablehnung, Umleitung an eine andere\n//! Kostenstelle/Organisationseinheit, oder eine erneute Prüfrunde nach\n//! Korrektur. `sgh-acctd` besitzt seine eigene `invoice_ingest`-Zeile (siehe\n//! oben) und muss über solche Änderungen informiert werden, sonst driftet ihr\n//! Status dauerhaft vom Plattform-Stand weg. Der Aufruf geht an dieselbe\n//! Edge-HMAC-authentifizierte Route-Familie wie [`shadow_ingest`]\n//! (`POST /shadow/status`, [`SHADOW_STATUS_PATH`]), mit identischem\n//! Header-/Signaturbau — [`resolve_auth_token`], [`resolve_edge_secret`] und\n//! [`edge_context_pairs`] sind zwischen beiden Aufrufpfaden geteilt, nicht\n//! dupliziert. Wie [`shadow_ingest`] ist [`shadow_status`] reines\n//! Best-Effort: `SGH_ACCT_SHADOW_ENABLED` gilt genauso, und jeder Fehler\n//! bleibt `tracing::warn!` statt den Aufrufer zu brechen.\n//!\n//! ## Examples\n//!\n//! ```rust,no_run\n//! use sgh_flow::services::acct_shadow::{shadow_ingest, ShadowIngestPayload};\n//! use serde_json::json;\n//! use uuid::Uuid;\n//!\n//! # async fn example() {\n//! let payload = ShadowIngestPayload {\n//!     ingest_id: Uuid::new_v4(),\n//!     original_filename: \"invoice.pdf\".to_owned(),\n//!     stored_filename: \"2026-08-04-abc123.pdf\".to_owned(),\n//!     storage_path: \"org/invoices/2026-08-04-abc123.pdf\".to_owned(),\n//!     checksum_hex: \"deadbeef\".to_owned(),\n//!     byte_size: 12345,\n//!     encoding: \"application/pdf\".to_owned(),\n//!     organization_id: Uuid::new_v4(),\n//!     json_payload: Some(json!({\"DOCUMENTHEADER\": {}})),\n//! };\n//! // Fire-and-forget: never blocks or fails the caller.\n//! tokio::spawn(shadow_ingest(payload));\n//! # }\n//! ```\n\nuse std::time::Duration;\n\nuse chrono::Utc;\nuse serde::Serialize;\nuse serde_json::Value;\nuse uuid::Uuid;\n\nuse crate::platform::envelope::{\n    HEADER_EDGE_SIGNATURE, HEADER_EDGE_TIMESTAMP, HEADER_ORG_ID, HEADER_SUBJECT_ID,\n};\nuse crate::services::acct_client::{ACCT_READ_SERVICE_SUBJECT, AcctClientError, edge_signature};\n\n/// Default `sgh-acctd` base URL when `SGH_ACCT_URL` is unset.\nconst DEFAULT_SGH_ACCT_URL: &str = \"http://127.0.0.1:4610\";\n\n/// Fixed timeout for the shadow-ingest POST — the caller must never be\n/// blocked waiting on `sgh-acctd`.\nconst SHADOW_INGEST_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(3);\n\n/// Pfad von [`shadow_status`]s `sgh-acctd`-Route, relativ zur `SGH_ACCT_URL`.\n///\n/// Dieselbe Edge-HMAC-Authentifizierung wie `/shadow/ingest`, siehe\n/// `sgh-acct/crates/sgh-acctd/src/app.rs::handle_shadow_status`.\npub const SHADOW_STATUS_PATH: &str = \"/shadow/status\";\n\n/// Primärer Variablenname des geteilten Bearer-Geheimnisses — derselbe Name,\n/// den `sgh-acctd` selbst zwingend liest (`sgh_acct_config::AppConfig`).\nconst ACCT_TOKEN_VAR: &str = \"SGH_ACCT_AUTH_TOKEN\";\n\n/// Rückfall auf den plattformseitigen Namen desselben Geheimnisses. Beide\n/// Namen tragen per Vertrag denselben Wert (siehe\n/// `cli::ensure_acct_auth_secret`, das sie in einem Zug verteilt); die\n/// Dashboard-Seite liest bereits diesen Namen (`api::dashboard`). Der Rückfall\n/// steht hier, damit eine Bestandsinstallation, in deren Laufzeit-Env nur der\n/// Plattformname provisioniert wurde, nicht schweigend auf „kein Secret\"\n/// fällt — genau derselbe Rückfall existiert auf der acct-Seite\n/// (`sgh-acctd/src/app.rs`, Legacy-Schreibweise).\nconst PARTICIPANT_SECRET_VAR: &str = \"PARTICIPANT_SGH_ACCT_AUTH_TOKEN_SECRET\";\n\n/// Historische Schreibweise desselben Participant-Geheimnisses mit Bindestrich.\n///\n/// `sgh-acctd` liest genau diese beiden Namen in genau dieser Reihenfolge als\n/// **Edge-Secret** (`sgh-acct/crates/sgh-acctd/src/app.rs`,\n/// `EDGE_SECRET_VAR` / `EDGE_SECRET_VAR_LEGACY`, nachgeschlagen). Steht in\n/// einer Bestandsinstallation nur der Bindestrich-Name, signiert diese Seite\n/// ohne den Rückfall mit einem anderen Schlüssel als die Gegenseite prüft — und\n/// jeder Shadow-Ingest würde mit `401` abgelehnt.\nconst PARTICIPANT_SECRET_VAR_LEGACY: &str = \"PARTICIPANT_SGH-ACCT_AUTH_TOKEN_SECRET\";\n\n/// Wählt das zu verwendende Bearer-Geheimnis aus zwei Kandidaten.\n///\n/// # Description\n///\n/// Reiner Kern ohne Env-Zugriff: der erste nicht-leere Kandidat gewinnt,\n/// [`ACCT_TOKEN_VAR`] vor [`PARTICIPANT_SECRET_VAR`]. Leerstrings gelten als\n/// „nicht konfiguriert\" — eine gesetzte, aber leere Variable ist genauso\n/// unbrauchbar wie eine fehlende.\n///\n/// # Arguments\n///\n/// - `primary` (`Option<&str>`): Wert von [`ACCT_TOKEN_VAR`], falls gesetzt.\n/// - `fallback` (`Option<&str>`): Wert von [`PARTICIPANT_SECRET_VAR`], falls\n///   gesetzt.\n///\n/// # Returns\n///\n/// `Some(token)` mit dem getrimmten Geheimnis, sonst `None`.\nfn resolve_auth_token(primary: Option<&str>, fallback: Option<&str>) -> Option<String> {\n    [primary, fallback]\n        .into_iter()\n        .flatten()\n        .map(str::trim)\n        .find(|value| !value.is_empty())\n        .map(str::to_owned)\n}\n\n/// Wählt das Edge-Geheimnis, mit dem der Kontext signiert wird.\n///\n/// # Description\n///\n/// Reiner Kern ohne Env-Zugriff — dieselbe Auswahlregel und dieselbe\n/// Reihenfolge, die `sgh-acctd::app::load_edge_secret` auf der Prüfseite\n/// anwendet: [`PARTICIPANT_SECRET_VAR`] vor\n/// [`PARTICIPANT_SECRET_VAR_LEGACY`], Leerstrings gelten als „nicht\n/// konfiguriert\". Getrennt von [`resolve_auth_token`] geführt, weil es zwei\n/// verschiedene Rollen sind: das Bearer-Token weist den *Aufrufer* aus, das\n/// Edge-Geheimnis beweist die *Mandantenzuordnung*.\n///\n/// # Arguments\n///\n/// - `primary` (`Option<&str>`): Wert von [`PARTICIPANT_SECRET_VAR`].\n/// - `legacy` (`Option<&str>`): Wert von [`PARTICIPANT_SECRET_VAR_LEGACY`].\n///\n/// # Returns\n///\n/// `Some(secret)` mit dem getrimmten Geheimnis, sonst `None`.\nfn resolve_edge_secret(primary: Option<&str>, legacy: Option<&str>) -> Option<String> {\n    [primary, legacy]\n        .into_iter()\n        .flatten()\n        .map(str::trim)\n        .find(|value| !value.is_empty())\n        .map(str::to_owned)\n}\n\n/// Baut die vier `X-SGH-*`-Kopfzeilen des verifizierten Edge-Kontexts.\n///\n/// # Description\n///\n/// Der Zeitstempel ist ein **Parameter**, kein zweiter Uhrenblick: Kopfzeile\n/// und Signatur müssen denselben Wert tragen, sonst schlägt die Prüfung auf\n/// der Gegenseite fehl. no\n    #                                              such tool exists yet, so we\n    #                                              only flag the gap here.\n    #   \"no_decision\"                           -- delivery_decision itself is\n    #                                              absent (agent didn't run /\n    #                                              produced nothing usable).\n    recipient_resolution: str = \"no_decision\"\n    history: List[Dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)\n    normalized_map: Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=dict)\n\n    def record_item(self, item_key: str, decision: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:\n        self.normalized_map[item_key] = decision\n\n    def apply_agent_metadata(self, agent_result: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Merge vendor/delivery hints produced by the agent network.\n\n        Delivery routing precedence: the MCP-grounded ``delivery_decision``\n        (produced by DELIVERY_AGENT via department_categories/department_page/\n        department_users tool calls and harvested into\n        ``run_ctx.delivery_decision`` by run_delivery_analysis) is the PRIMARY\n        source. It is only usable when it carries a resolved department or\n        recipient — an empty/low-confidence decision falls back to the\n        pre-existing keyword/segment heuristic already stored in\n        ``self.delivery_to`` by VendorDeliveryResolver.resolve() (the SAFETY\n        NET path).\n        \"\"\"\n        vendor_info = _first_dict(\n            agent_result,\n            \"vendor\",\n            \"vendor_summary\",\n            \"supplier\",\n            \"vendor_profile\",\n        )\n        if vendor_info:\n            vendor_candidate = vendor_info.get(\"vendor_no\") or vendor_info.get(\"id\") or vendor_info.get(\"number\")\n            numeric_vendor = _digits_only(vendor_candidate)\n            if numeric_vendor:\n                self.vendor_no = numeric_vendor\n            self.vendor_name = vendor_info.get(\"vendor_name\") or vendor_info.get(\"name\") or self.vendor_name\n        delivery_info = agent_result.get(\"delivery\") or agent_result.get(\"delivery_to\") or agent_result.get(\"delivery_summary\")\n        if isinstance(delivery_info, dict):\n            self.delivery_to = delivery_info.get(\"delivery_to\") or delivery_info.get(\"value\") or self.delivery_to\n        elif isinstance(delivery_info, str) and delivery_info.strip():\n            self.delivery_to = delivery_info\n\n        # PRIMARY: MCP-grounded delivery_decision from DELIVERY_AGENT.\n        decision = agent_result.get(\"delivery_decision\")\n        if isinstance(decision, dict):\n            has_recipient = bool(decision.get(\"recipient_user_id\"))\n            has_department = bool(decision.get(\"department_name\") or decision.get(\"department_id\"))\n            if has_recipient or has_department:\n                self.delivery_decision = decision\n                # are still exposed separately in response[\"delivery\"].\n                resolved_label = (\n                    decision.get(\"department_name\")\n                    or decision.get(\"recipient_user_name\")\n                    or decision.get(\"department_category\")\n                )\n                if resolved_label:\n                    self.delivery_to = resolved_label\n                if has_recipient:\n                    self.recipient_resolution = \"resolved\"\n                else:\n                    # As of 2026-07, department_user /\n                    # cost_center_approver are EMPTY for every org, so this\n                    # is the expected/common outcome, not an anomaly. We do\n                    # NOT silently drop the routing signal or invent a\n                    # recipient; a real admin-fallback requires a Rust MCP\n                    # tool (e.g. list_org_admins) that does not exist yet.\n                    self.recipient_resolution = \"no_department_assignment_fallback_to_admin_needed\"\n            else:\n                self.recipient_resolution = \"no_department_assignment_fallback_to_admin_needed\"\n\n\nclass VendorDeliveryResolver:\n    \"\"\"Pre-processing resolver for vendor and delivery hints from the invoice header.\n\n    The DB-fallback (get_recent_ai_lines) has been removed (MCP migration).\n    Vendor identity is now resolved by the VendorGL specialist via the MCP\n    lookup_vendor tool during the agent run. context.delivery_to = \"Direktpflege\"\n            elif \"office\" in segments:\n                context.delivery_to = \"Einkauf\"\n            else:\n                context.delivery_to = \"Technik\"\n\n    def _extract_vendor_from_header(self, header: str) -> Optional[str]:\n        for token in header.split():\n            if token.isdigit() and len(token) >= 4:\n                return token\n        return None\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass GLDecision:\n    position: int\n    item_text: str\n    segment: str\n    final_gl_account: str\n    final_account_name: Optional[str]\n \"account_name\", \"konto_name\")\n        confidence = self._parse_float(self._first_value(candidate, entry, None, \"confidence\", \"score\", \"similarity\"))\n        reasoning = (\n selected_account = candidate.get(\"gl_account\") or candidate.get(\"final_gl_account\") or gl_account\n        LOG.debug(\n            \"GL decision pos=%s segment=%s final_gl_account=%s A network\n# blip must not leave a genuinely completed job stuck un-notified.\n_NOTIFY_COMPLETE_MAX_ATTEMPTS = 3\n_NOTIFY_COMPLETE_BACKOFF_SECS = (1.0, 2.0)\n\n\nasync def _notify_job_complete(\n    invoice_id: str,\n    ownership: Dict[str, Any],\n    *,\n    result_ref: Optional[str] = None,\n    worker_token: Optional[str] = None,\n    organization_id: Optional[str] = None,\n    subject_id: Optional[str] = None,\n) -> None:\n    \"\"\"POST /process/complete to mark the DB job row COMPLETED.\n\n    Same ownership body shape as ``/process/fail`` (``request_id``,\n    ``worker_instance_id``, ``claim_token`` — see ``OwnershipRequest`` in\n    ``sgh-acctd/src/app/worker_api.rs``), plus an optional ``result_ref``.\n    Non-fatal: all errors are swallowed and logged so the caller's success\n    path is never interrupted by a notification failure.\n\n    Idempotent: retried up to :data:`_NOTIFY_COMPLETE_MAX_ATTEMPTS` times\n    with backoff on network errors or non-2xx/non-terminal responses. skipping /process/complete notification for invoice %s\",\n            invoice_id,\n        )\n        return\n    base_url = _resolve_worker_base_url()\n    url = f\"{base_url}/api/v1/invoices/{invoice_id}/process/complete\"\n    headers = _build_worker_headers(resolved_token, organization_id, subject_id)\n    body = {\n        \"request_id\": ownership.get(\"request_id\"),\n        \"worker_instance_id\": ownership.get(\"worker_instance_id\"),\n        \"claim_token\": ownership.get(\"claim_token\"),\n        \"result_ref\": result_ref,\n    }\n    import httpx\n\n    for attempt in range(1, _NOTIFY_COMPLETE_MAX_ATTEMPTS + 1):\n        try:\n            async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=10.0) as client:\n                response = await client.post(url, headers=headers, content=json.dumps(body))\n            if 200 <= response.status_code < 300:\n                LOG.debug(\"Job completion notification accepted for invoice %s (attempt %s)\", invoice_id, attempt)\n                return\n            response_text = response.text[:300]\n            if \"already completed\" in response_text.lower():\n                LOG.debug(\n                    \"Job completion notification for invoice %s already applied (idempotent, attempt %s)\",\n                    invoice_id,\n                    attempt,\n                )\n                return\n            if response.status_code == 403 and response_text.strip().lower().startswith(\"lease lost\"):\n                LOG.warning(\n                    \"Lease lost;
